description: This Java class defines a global error controller for a Spring Boot application, handling errors routed to the /error endpoint and returning JSON error responses. It prevents the default error page from being shown and excludes certain paths like Swagger UI and health checks from this controller.

classes.name: GlobalErrorController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller implementing ErrorController to handle all /error requests and return JSON formatted error details.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles error requests to /error endpoint, constructs a JSON response containing timestamp, status code, error message, request path, and exception details if available.
